headline: Peres Jepchirchir Banned Following Positive Doping Test Results
metaDescription: Olympic gold medalist Peres Jepchirchir has received a three-year competition ban after testing positive for EPO, leading to her Sydney Marathon…
aiSummaryBullets: Peres Jepchirchir has been issued a three-year competition ban for violating anti-doping regulations.
The athlete tested positive for EPO following an out-of-competition sample collected in Kenya prior to the August event.
Her victory at the 2026 Sydney Marathon has been revoked following the confirmation of the doping violation.
aiContextParagraph: Kenyan athlete Peres Jepchirchir has been disqualified from her 2026 Sydney Marathon title after receiving a three-year suspension for a doping violation. The Athletics Integrity Unit (AIU) confirmed that an out-of-competition sample collected in Kenya before the marathon returned an Adverse Analytical Finding for the performance-enhancing substance EPO. This result, received in mid-September 2026, prompted a provisional suspension on October 20. Jepchirchir, a decorated long-distance runner, is a four-time World Marathon Major winner and was the 2021 Olympic Games gold medalist. This development follows a series of recent doping-related bans affecting Kenyan athletes. The AIU continues to oversee investigations and sample collections aimed at ensuring compliance with international sports regulations. The revocation of the Sydney Marathon title serves as an administrative consequence of the confirmed violation found during the testing period leading up to the race.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to significant search interest regarding the athlete's name, coupled with coverage from two independent media outlets.
